newsitem.title: USA: Agouron, Nastech in common cold pact.
newsitem.headline: Agouron, Nastech in common cold pact.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that it and Nastech Pharmaceutical Co have agreed to develop a nasally delivered formulation of an Agouron rhinovirus 3C protease (RVP) inhibitor drug for prevention or treatment of upper respiratory infections, or the common cold.
Nastech will apply its nasal drug delivery expertise and technology to identify a safe and effective nasal formulation of one or more of Agouron's anti-rhinovirus compounds.
Nastech will receive royalty payments from Agouron's sales of any RVP inhibitor incorporating Nastech's intranasal technology.
